text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"One truck of illuminations from the 
racecourse has arrived! 
Go ahead and direct them over toward the 
stage!"

text_block_list.name: Cool Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, is that for the parade...? 
Didn't they say it was getting 
cancelled...?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Heh... Not on our watch. 
We're prepping for it with everything 
we've got."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, all we can do now is push 
forward...! 
Gotta stay fired up...!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? Here it comes♪ 
Special access privileges to the Umalator 
network server...!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like all that convincing paid off. 
As expected of our leader♪"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"As long as it's something thrilling to 
see, huh...? 
Never imagined it'd turn into something 
this big though~."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "I don't want to leave anyone behind."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...You sure shine bright, Rickey-chan. 
Sometimes... I gotta admit, I'm a little 
envious."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Now you've gone and made me want to 
reach out too. 
Reach this hand of mine out, that is."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to the strongest data 
processing power in the academy... it's 
gotta be the VR Umalator. 
To 'connect everything together', I'll be 
borrowing your strength, Three Goddesses."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Those go on later, so please keep them 
under the roof for now. 
I'm so sorry for making you stay and help 
for such long hours."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about? We're not 
gonna let Buena-chan do all the work while 
we slack off. 
You can rely on us more, you know. Don't 
be so shy about it."

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yeah. Besides... Buena-san, you're 
always so kind to us, so... I-I've always 
wanted to help you out sometime..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much...! Everyone's feelings 
are so warm and kind—... I'll do my very, 
very best too! To make this happen!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Even just whatever leftover lights you 
have is fine! 
Please, we really need your help!"

text_block_list.name: Event Company President
text_block_list.text:
"Quite lively today, isn't it... Hm? 
You're... ah, that girl! 
The one from the races... and the feng 
shui girl on TV!"

text_block_list.name: Event Company President
text_block_list.text:
"My granddaughter's a huge fan of yours! 
Think you could teach me some good luck 
tips to help my granddaughter with her 
exams? 
In return, I'll help you out with whatever 
you need! Deal?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Good qi might finally be flowing our way. 
The company president made some calls for 
me, so if I go around Tokyo, I can secure 
the numbers we need! ...The problem is how 
to transport them, though—"

text_block_list.name: Fierce-Looking Man
text_block_list.text: It's nowhere to be found... Damn it all...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Um, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fierce-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Oooohhh...! I looked everywhere and 
thought it was gone for good... You're 
amazing, young lady!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I just made an educated guess based on 
the route you walked and your current 
lucky direction according to your 
birthdate. 
I'm so glad you found your wallet!"

text_block_list.name: Fierce-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Money can always be earned back, but I 
couldn't bear to lose that photo of my 
wife and kids. 
I owe you one."

text_block_list.name: Fierce-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever find yourself in a pinch... 
just say the word. 
If a decotora's fine with ya... I'll haul 
ass anywhere to help you out!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh no, please don't worry about it! 
...Well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll be 
going...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait! 
By 'decotora'... do you mean a heavy-duty 
truck?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It's been two days since then... 
Combining the additional materials that 
arrived, we've covered about... 70% of the 
planned decoration area, I'd say."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Rickey-chan—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you all waiting!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I brought every single bit of the 
remaining decorations!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Every single bit...? Where the heck could 
you even— 
Whoaaa?! What is that?! A decotora's 
pulling up?!"

text_block_list.name: Fierce-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, young lady~! Is it alright to unload 
right here~?! 
There's ten more trucks right behind me!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes! Thank you so much for 
everything~!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"A good flow of qi really does circulate 
between people! 
All these connections with everyone 
brought about this wonderful result!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Tran-san is taking care of the staging 
tools... 
And now all the lighting we need is here, 
so—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Everything delivered so far has 
already been set up. 
All that's left is to assemble what just 
arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The deadline is by the end of today. We 
have to make it in time with just our 
current hands, huh... 
If only I could've gotten back sooner..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Rickey-chan! Everyone did an 
amazing job☆ 
And from here on out~... it's Falco's 
turn!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When you need to grab everyone's attention 
at a time like this—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai☆ Full speed ahead, today too! 
It's your Fan Appreciation Festival Parade 
Team Leader, Falco-desu~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"(It's gotta be a surprise guerilla live, 
of course☆ 
...I won't let everyone's connected 
feelings come to a halt!)"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Did you know? The parade at this year's 
Appreciation Festival is called 
the 'Dreamy Night Parade That Connects 
Everyone.'"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait... is this being broadcast across the 
whole school...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like it. 
Falco-san, could she be...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"From Falco and the team putting on the 
parade, to every single guest coming to 
the academy to watch—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even people who couldn't make it can still 
connect with us... 
That's what makes this parade so special!☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco, you know, absolutely loves 
call-and-response during live shows!☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That feeling of becoming one with everyone 
through a single piece of music... 
No matter how many times I do it, or how 
much time passes, I'll never forget that 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This parade, you see, will let the people 
who couldn't come to the venue 
share that very same feeling with us♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What connects everyone in this parade 
isn't our voices. It's light. 
But to 'connect everyone'... we're still 
just a little bit short on power.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You've got quite the clever touch, 
Falco-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about another little 
push... 
Let's give 'em a 70% sneak peek of the 
light show that connects everyone, nya~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A parade that connects us with people far 
away—I want to do this, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to deliver these precious feelings 
in my heart. 
And I'm sure every single one of you has 
someone like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Let's deliver hope together with 
Falco and the others! 
To that special someone who means the 
world to you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because the light from these illuminations 
is the light of our hearts. 
It'll connect your heart with the people 
you love!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can reach the whole world! With our 
burning, passionate feelings! 
The more everyone's power comes together, 
the further our light will spread!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With everyone we want to enjoy this 
parade— 
Let's spend a wonderfully happy time 
together in this special parade!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Once your friends' and fellow parade 
members' faces come to mind—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll want to see it too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's create it together, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One that connects everyone... A dreamily 
happy—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The ultimate—'Dreamy Night Parade'!

text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Should I help with installing the 
illuminations being unloaded right now? 
...Since we're doing the Fan Thanksgiving 
anyway, we wouldn't want it to feel 
lackluster, right?

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I called over the folks from my class too, 
so hit us up with our assigned work area~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... People are gathering in droves all 
at once...! 
Not bad, Leader. Guess we can't afford to 
slack off either.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If the lights that we—that all of us put 
up 
can connect us to what's important to us—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, you guys! 
We are DEFINITELY making it in time...!
